snippet.title: Sonic Scramble - Sonic & Knuckles Demo Release
snippet.description:
GET READY FOR SONIC SCRAMBLE

Play in a NEW Sonic the Hedgehog platform fighting game featuring Sonic and Knuckles with a meter system like no other! Play locally or online with Rollback Netcode and learn the games mechanics through the games discord or independently through the games extensive training mode

Available NOW!

Disclaimer: This is a hobby project that I have worked on for the last 10 months. I am not a game programmer traditionally and I have very little experience prior to this. I expect this project won't be perfect, but for what it is currently I am happy with my work. Thank you all for the support over the last several months

CURRENT DOWNLOAD - PATCH 0.1.3: https://gamejolt.com/games/sonicscramble/1046635

Discord: https://discord.gg/cW9Xn96
